must_not_claim: The app or health endpoint was observed live during this analysis.
The recorded health response establishes current runtime state.
The background worker is deployed or observed.
The durable queue is deployed or observed.

presentation_requirements: Every load-bearing claim has a visible evidence ID.
The SVG contains an evidence index with state and file:line locators.
Every evidence ID replays to a supporting locator.
Recorded runtime evidence shows its observation time and a freshness qualification.
The SVG says live runtime was not inspected.
Unsupported details are labeled inference or unverified.
